notes: Multi-item inventory renders C's list_obj_to_char mode-15 table (Num/Item/Encumbrance, grouped, reverse discovery order). Previously untestable: the oracle's oc_show_list self-aliasing sprintf UB clobbered item names (fixed in the oracle, same class as make_prompt/exits).
The mode-15 renderer is shared with look-in/examine container display; proven jointly.
C-first real inventory reaches the wide mode-15 table and compares the lowercase encumbrance header (R1/R2/R5e/R5g/R5h).
C-first inventory renders an indexed ITEM_INVISIBLE row and compares the exact extra line (R1/R2/R5e/R5g/R5h).
C-first inventory renders an indexed ITEM_BLESS row after detect alignment and compares the exact blue-glow extra (R1/R2/R5e/R5g/R5h).

C-unreachable: list_obj_to_char initializes every new howmany node with count=1 and oc_onlist only increments matching nodes; oc_show_list runs only when found. Thus a displayed node can never enter the count<=0 error row (R1/R5e/R5g).
